create_FastAgent: create a FastAgent instance with a name string for an MCP server application
build_agent_decorator: build an agent using the @fast.agent decorator with name, instruction, and servers parameters
run_agent_context: run the FastAgent application as an async context manager and obtain an agent instance
start_agent_interactive: start the agent in interactive mode for user conversation
get_skybridge_config: get the SkybridgeServerConfig for a named skybridge server from the agent aggregator
